commands.description: The AI commands this workspace offers, listed by 'Run AI Command'

id.description: Stable key. Bind a keybinding to it with { "command": "myDevTools.runAiCommand", "args": { "id": "..." } }, and shadow a global command of the same id. Only letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_' can become a palette entry through 'AI: Sync Commands to Palette'

title.description: Label shown in the command picker

description.description: Detail line shown under the title in the picker

prompt.description: The instruction sent to the model. An array is joined with newlines. Supports ${input:id}, ${file}, ${relativeFile}, ${fileBasename}, ${fileBasenameNoExtension}, ${fileDirname}, ${languageId}, ${workspaceFolder} and ${selection}

system.description: Extra system-level instructions for this command, appended to the built-in ones

globs.description: The command is only offered for files matching one of these, e.g. ["**/*.tsx"]. Omit to offer it everywhere

enumDescriptions: Never tell the model what is selected
Send the whole file, point at the selected range (or the caret) by its line:column coordinates, and rewrite the whole file
Send only the selected text and replace only it; falls back to the whole file when nothing is selected
The reply is the file's new content
The reply is the selection's new content
The reply is one or more <file path="..."> blocks, created or overwritten
The reply is inserted on a new line below the selection
The reply is copied to the clipboard and nothing is edited
output.description: Defaults to replaceSelection when selection is "target", otherwise replaceFile

newFilePath.description: Suggested location passed to the model when output is "files", e.g. ${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.test.ts. The model may choose otherwise

inputs.description: Questions asked before the request. Answers are substituted as ${input:id}

rules.description: Attach the rule files whose frontmatter 'paths' match the edited file

ruleFiles.description: Rule file names always attached regardless of their 'paths', e.g. ["testing.md"]

contextFiles.description: Extra workspace files attached read-only, as globs. Useful for handing the model an existing file as a style example

model.description: OpenRouter model for this command. Defaults to myDevTools.ai.model, then myDevTools.openRouter.model

maxTokens.description: Cap on the reply length. Leave unset for a whole-file rewrite, where truncation costs the file

label.description: The question, shown as the prompt of the box

required.description: Escaping a required question cancels the command; escaping an optional one substitutes nothing
